text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san, happy birthday. Please, allow 
me to celebrate with you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Um, Heart-san, you like reptiles, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I even go to reptile cafes quite 
often! They're humorous, pleasantly cool 
to the touch, and totally cute♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, bringing up a topic like that, could 
it be...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I came up with a special celebration 
unique to me, wonderful just like a 
reptile café.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to head to the mountain 
behind the academy to interact with some 
wild reptiles?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm really good at finding things! When I 
reach under bridges or into rock crevices, 
there are often lots of newt-sans and such 
around!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And then there are lizards and snakes 
too... Ah, but of course I can tell 
whether they're poisonous or not, so don't 
worry!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's fantastic! You really are a wild 
girl contrary to your looks!"
